title: feat(objectql)!: two namespaces may each ship a flow of one name; addresses, actions and endpoints run their own package's (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7hU4nqZzq4X97nuFabGxKv)_
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYAGCZcafN5hk3uj4u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 名字从「整个部署只能一个包持有」改成「每个命名空间一个包」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各自发同名 flow，各跑各的；同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、内置名仍然拒绝。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D9，史诗 #31527 子卡 B 的 flow 部分，这是第三个也是收尾的 PR。之前第二个包装同名 flow 直接 422，只能改名。
- 谁按包作答：`/automation/:ns/:name` 的读、运行、开关、运行记录，以及运行上的 resume / cancel / restore-suspension / 屏幕读，都按该命名空间那个包的槽来服务；裸的运行门（按 runId）按该运行自己的槽处理，Console 和 MCP `resume_run` 都能继续暂停的屏幕流程；包自己的 flow action 和 flow endpoint 跑自己包的 flow（D3），启动准入按调用流程的包读子流程；审批请求开单时记下运行所属的包（`process_package`），退回修改、请求详情的路线和步骤、重新提交都按请求自己的槽读 flow。裸名、没有包的 action 和 endpoint、不带包的独立 action 仍然 409，并列出两个持有者。
- 风险与回滚：收窄两处（裸 `/meta/flow` 读两持有者的名字答 409；包调用方按名读只有环境持有、或只有闭包外的包持有的 flow 被拒），第一方调用方 0，dogfood 全量见下方。Studio 的 flow 面板（读、运行、开关、运行列表）还按裸名调用，共享名会看到 409，另开 follow-up；按 runId 的运行门不受影响。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/flow-slot-view.ts`，再看 `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`，最后看下方 FROM → TO 表。
- 需要你做的：无。第三轮推送前已再合 main（be75078a4，未 rebase），合入后重装、重建、重跑相关套件；第四轮（审批，裁定 6817831965）未再合 main（K=6）；由专题席位安排落地。

Fixes #31696

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — two refusals where a flow was served: the bare `GET /meta/flow/NAME` and `MetadataManager.get('flow', NAME)` with no package answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both holders of a name two packages hold, where they served the first registered; and a package's by-name read of a flow through the registry's package-scoped read refuses a name only the environment holds (D3 (a)) or one package outside its closure holds (D3 step 3), where it served it. Beside them, widenings: the install door, the item seam, the cold boot's seal and the cloud `install-local` door admit a second holder of another namespace (was `422`; the install-local door now `200`); `/automation/:ns/:name` serves that namespace's holder of a shared name at every by-name door, the run read, screen read and the run-lifecycle writes (resume, cancel, restore-suspension) included (was `409`); the bare run doors act on a run of a shared name in the run's own slot (was `409`); and MCP `resume_run` continues such a run through the flow action of the run's own package (was `403`). Every moved answer is in the table below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none in this PR — `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`'s `subflow` row reads two holders of a flow name as "an older clash, never armed"; once two namespaces' flows are armed, that parenthetical is out of date. `skills/**` is outside this card's surface, so it is a follow-up for the skills lane. No doc in `content/docs/` teaches a flow name as one per deployment.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (the dogfood battery, below, boots every example app with the change). The two first-party callers of a run on a shared name, the Console's screen runner (it resumes at the bare `/automation/{flow}/runs/{runId}/resume`) and MCP `resume_run`, are served from the run's own slot (rows 14 and 16), pinned on a booted stack.

## What changes

- **The switch.** `flow` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`@objectstack/core`), `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (`@objectstack/metadata`) and `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (`@objectstack/objectql`) in one stroke. The bare-name rule (`bare-name-one-holder.ts`) is set-driven, so only its docs move.
- **`/automation` addresses** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`, `automation.ts`). When an address's namespace names the one holder of a shared name, `admitAutomationAddress` answers `slot` instead of `409`, and the door reads through `flowSlotView` (new, `packages/runtime/src/flow-slot-view.ts`): the same service with `execute`, `getFlow`, `toggleFlow`, the run lists and the run reads bound to that package's slot (`executeSlot`, `getFlowSlot`, `toggleFlowSlot`, `flowSlotKey`). Every step of the door reads the one flow; none falls back to the bare name. The writes keep their `409`.
- **Flow actions and flow endpoints** (`action-execution.ts`, `action-dispatch.ts`, `endpoint-executor.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.ts`). `flowServiceForCaller` resolves the `target` from the caller's package with `resolvePackageScopedName` (own item, else the one holder in the closure, else refused naming every candidate) only when the bare name is refused; a name one package holds keeps the bare read, exactly as before. The action's package is its own stamp; an action embedded in its object's `actions[]` (reference identity) without one takes its object's; a standalone item never does (`actionDeclaringPackage`). The endpoint's is the holder of its `api` item. No package, no registry, or no slot entries: the service itself, whose bare entries refuse (fail closed).
- **The start's record-read walk** (`flow-start-admission.ts`, `flowWalkReads` in `flow-slot-view.ts`). `flowDeclaredRecordReads` reads each `subflow` / `map` callee from the calling flow's package, as the engine's `resolveFlowKey` does: the started flow's package is the slot a door's view is bound to, else the one holder of the bare name; a shared callee name resolves from the caller's package and is read from that holder's slot. The action, endpoint and trigger doors pass it. Without a registry or slot entries every callee is the bare read (fail closed). The walk's path key is `(package, name)`, so another namespace's callee of the same name is another flow, never a re-entry.
- **The run doors by run id** (`automation.ts`, `runSlotView`). A bare run door whose name the resolver refuses reads the run's key (`getRun`, else the suspended-run list); a key `PACKAGE/NAME` that is that slot's key serves the door from that slot, and any other key is served from the slot of the one holder the `409` names whose `flowSlotKey(pkg, name)` equals it (`runSlotPackage`; none, or two or more, keep the `409`). Under an address, the slot view reads a run filed under the bare name while that is not its own slot's key (the engine holding only another package's slot) as no run of the address.
- **MCP** (`mcp.ts`). `resume_run` splits the run's key (`runFlowOf`) and admits a candidate whose `target` resolves, from the candidate's package, to the run's package (`flowHolderForCaller`); a key that carries no package, of a shared name, takes its package from `runSlotPackage`, else is refused `409` naming every holder. `list_actions` reads a flow action's flow through `flowServiceForCaller` with the declaration's package.
- **The engine re-keys a run's records with its slot** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`, `moveFlowRecords`). When a second package takes a name, the incumbent's key moves from `NAME` to `PACKAGE/NAME`; besides the per-flow maps and the paused runs it already moved, the run-log ring's entries (finished runs included) move with it, and the moved key is remembered (`movedFlowKeys`, `flowKeyNow`) so a run still in flight under its start key, and a consumed pause put back by restore-suspension, are recorded and parked where the key went. Every other per-run store, and what it does on a move, is listed in the round-3 report.
- **R8: the boot binds every run row that names no package** (`stored-reference-package-backfill.ts`, epic seat ruling 6816878345). The stored-reference backfill asked `sys_automation_run` paused rows only; it now asks every row whose `flow_package` is null, terminal history included, and binds it to the flow's one package holder. A row of an environment-authored flow, or of a name two packages already hold, stays null, and the ambiguous names are reported, as before. So a history row written before `flow_package` existed reads as its package's run once a second namespace installs the name. No door's answer moves on a name one package holds; the column value moves (declared under R8 in the changeset).
- **R7: an approval request reads its flow from its own slot** (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, epic seat ruling 6817831965). A request names its flow by `process_name` (`flow:NAME`), and the engine's bare `getFlow` refuses a name two packages hold, so once a second namespace installed the name, send-back answered `409` and the request read lost `flow_route` and `flow_steps`. The request now records its run's package when it opens (`process_package`, from the slot the run's key is filed under: the approval node passes the engine's `flowKeyOfRun`), and every read of its flow goes through `requestFlow`: that package's slot, else the slot its run (`flow_run_id`: its suspension, else its record) is filed under, when exactly one is; else the bare read, which answers a one-holder name as before and keeps the refusal naming every holder. The five sites: the send-back's revise-edge check (`assertReviseEdge`), the read's route and steps (`attachFlowSteps`), the resubmit-window check (`expectedPauseNode`), the batch above a recalled item (by its parent run's key, `getRunFlow`), and the step's queue package (`flowPackageOf`, at open and on the legacy re-resolution, asked by the slot key). The R7 boot backfill already binds open requests with a null `process_package` from the one holder (`pending` and `returned`); its notes and the column's comment now name the readers. No answer moves on a name one package holds, and on a shared name send-back and the read answer as before the install, so no FROM → TO row; the column value moves (null → the run's package, at open), declared under R7 in the changeset.
- **Tests and doubles.** The objectql family pins, the e8 readers, the metadata slot pins and the protocol testkit (`no-package-scoped-reads.testkit.ts`: a double now reads `flow` by package) follow the switch; three runtime doubles declare `readsByPackage` for `flow`.

## Why

ADR-0150 D2/D9 narrow the one-holder rule to the namespace; D3 resolves a bare name from the caller's package; D4 slots the engine by `(package, name)`; D5 addresses a holder by namespace. PR-1 and PR-2 (#32374) landed the engine's slots, arming, triggers, hooks and the per-slot activation ledger. This PR turns the rule on for `flow` and makes every door that knows which package it means read that package's flow (seat ruling 6810580480: the action and endpoint doors in this PR, red line 3).

## Verification

- **R4-A approvals (ruling 6817831965)**: `approval-revise.test.ts` (the real engine; two packages' flows of one name, the second with no review node, so a wrong read refuses the send-back): requests opened before and after the second ships it carry P1; the read's `flow_steps` and `flow_route`, send-back and resubmit answer; a row with no package reads through its run; CONTROL: with no run to read either, the send-back is refused naming both, and the row stays pending. On a booted stack (`approval-flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts`: alpha's record-triggered approval flow, then `install-local` of iota shipping the name): requests opened before (one of them sent back) and after the install all store `process_package` alpha; `GET /approvals/requests/:id` carries `flow_steps` `['Alpha gate']` and `flow_route`, revise answers `200` (`returned`), resubmit `200`; a request whose `process_package` is nulled revises `200` through its run; CONTROL: nulled and pointed at a run nobody holds, revise answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming alpha and iota, and the row stays pending. Ablation (`requestFlow` back to the bare read; committed 097cb8f77 first): unit `Tests 2 failed | 24 passed (26)` (the read has no `flow_steps`; the send-back is refused naming both); dogfood red, read with soft assertions: both reads lose `flow_steps` and `flow_route`, revise answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming alpha and iota and the request stays `pending`, the no-package request `409`; resubmit `200` and the CONTROL `409` hold both ways; restored, green. The flow dogfood's `[R3]` case (review nit) also reads the bare cancel (`200`, the run `cancelled`), alpha's address resume (`200`, `completed`) and the finished run at alpha's address and the bare door (`200`, `completed`).
- **Suites (round 4)**: plugin-approvals 117 files / 1605 tests; plugin-approvals `pnpm typecheck` (tsc, scripts, `check:test-typecheck`) OK, no ledger growth; dogfood: the round-3 40 files plus every approvals dogfood file and every file booting the approvals plugin, 58 files: 58 passed, 453 tests passed; dogfood `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (8 GB heap).
- **R8 terminal rows (ruling 6816878345)**: `stored-reference-package-column.test.ts` binds a completed, a failed and a running row of a one-holder flow, and keeps a terminal row of a shared name and of an environment flow null (CONTROL, both reported); on a booted stack, a history row the boot found with no package is bound to alpha, then, with iota holding the name, alpha's address and the bare door read it (`200`, `completed`) and iota's address answers it as a run nobody holds. Ablation (the backfill narrowed back to paused rows): the unit pin goes red (`r7`–`r9` stay null), and the booted-stack pin goes red: the column stays null, alpha's address answers `404 RUN_NOT_FOUND`, the bare door `409` naming alpha and iota; restored, green.
- **Round 3 (contract review 6815835857, ruling 6815858549), red first**: with the round-3 source reverted to the round-2 head 2c650351 and the new pins kept, the two engine pins fail (the paused, finished and stranded runs, and a run in flight, read `f` where `PACKAGE/f` is expected), the three MCP `[R3-B]` pins fail, and the five lone-slot bare-door pins fail (`409`); restored, all pass.
- **Round 3 ablation (the re-key)**: with the ring re-key and the moved-key forwarding taken out of `moveFlowRecords`, the two engine pins go red, and the booted-stack pin goes red at every door it reads: `getRun` keeps the bare key, alpha's address answers the screen read `404` (as nobody's), the bare screen read and resume answer `409` naming alpha and iota, MCP `resume_run` answers `409` naming both, and both runs stay `paused`; restored, green.
- **Round 2 (contract review 6814434131, ruling 6814454746), red first**: with the six round-2 source files (`action-execution.ts`, `flow-start-admission.ts`, `flow-slot-view.ts`, `endpoint-executor.ts`, `domains/automation.ts`, `domains/mcp.ts`) reverted to the round-1 head f845bef6 and the new pins kept, 24 of the 120 tests in the four touched files fail (the standalone action, the three walk doors and the walk's 404, the bare run doors served and by the suspended list, the address's M1 refusal, MCP `resume_run`, `list_actions`); restored, 120 of 120 pass. The address's own-run / other-run pins pass on both (the behaviour the review measured; this round declares and pins it). The dogfood file on the reverted source fails at the bare screen read (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`); restored, 10 of 10.
- **Round 2 ablation**: the bare run doors' `runSlotView` replaced by `undefined` turns 11 of 57 run-door pins red (each door's bare served pin and suspended-list pin, and the bare run read's name); restored, 57 of 57.
- **Round 1, red first, on `main` f0f729e7**: with the six runtime wiring files reverted to `main` (the new `flow-slot-view.ts` kept), exactly the four "served" pins fail (P's action, P's endpoint, the address read/run/toggle/runs, the address run read); the other 49, every CONTROL included, pass.
- **Round 1 ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored to HEAD): `flowServiceForCaller` returning the bare service instead of the slot view turns exactly the four served pins red (own flow, closure holder, P's action, P's endpoint); the 49 others stay green.

- **Typecheck**: runtime `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck` OK (no ledger growth); dogfood `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (with an 8 GB heap; the default heap runs out in this container). Round 1: core, objectql, metadata, metadata-protocol clean.
- **`pnpm lint`**: exit 0 on the round-4 head (097cb8f77).
- **Gates (round 4)**: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the round-4 tree (45 paths): 85 derived, each exit code recorded before any pipe; 84 exit 0; 1 NOT MEASURED, the same `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3). `--ran`: 85 derived, 84 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Gates** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the round-3 merged tree, each exit code recorded before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`): 81 derived; 80 exit 0; 1 NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 (its self-test does not reach its verdict in this container; CI's "Plugin teardown-shape gate" is green). `--ran`: 81 derived, 80 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
